svg.title: Figure 2. Equilibrium and compatibility for two members between caps
svg.desc: Three sketches. (a) Two members standing on a base before loading: member 1 has length L, member 2 is shorter by a gap g. (b) Free-body diagram of the rigid cap: the press load P acts down, and the two members push up with forces minus F1 and minus F2, so equilibrium gives F1 plus F2 equals minus P with tension positive. (c) After loading both members end at the same cap position, so L plus delta 1 equals L minus g plus delta 2, where each delta is F L over E A plus alpha delta T L.
